record.summary: No qualifying institute or commitment identified. Government AI measures include an ethical code adopted in May 2024 and support for business adoption discussed at the February 2025 AI Action Summit. Neither announcement designates an institute to evaluate advanced models.

check.language_note: The recorded ca query uses a national or official language selected for this country-specific check. Other national or official languages were not exhaustively searched. Search source_ids identify registered source URLs matched in the retrieved result set, which may include irrelevant hits. An empty list means no registered source URL was matched, not that the web response was empty. The earlier audit used independent_source_ids for substantive corroboration; governance_source_ids, where present, identifies the selected primary governance evidence. English queries were also run on 17 October 2026; the previously recorded national or official-language coverage and its limits are unchanged.
check.independence_note: Historical audit under the superseded two-independent-sources rule: Two substantively independent evidence origins were not established. Multiple pages from one owner, mirrors, reports of the same underlying announcement and general regional coverage are not counted as independent corroboration.
check.governance_note: The government announcement describes an approved ethical code for AI use. The partly read digital-government home page is not used as the governance evidence.

record.notes: Read the government ethical-code announcement and AI Action Summit/business-support announcement in Catalan. They describe responsible adoption, human rights, governance and digital cooperation, without a qualifying institute or an institute-specific study. Search results for university institutes were general research or foreign bodies. Previous broad-search source retained for provenance. Absence remains provisional.
